algorithms.title: Incident Close-Out
steps: Confirm no patients remain (re-sweep scene, check green area, search for self-evacuees).
Reconcile counts: tags = transport log = hospital arrivals + dead + released on scene.
Phased demobilization: rehab/medical check → decon → restock → return to service; log each release.
AAR/Improvement Plan within weeks; update plans, train, and drill.
PFA and peer follow-up at ~1 day, 1 week, 1 month.
